product_metadata.title: bHome & Co. Pantry Organization and Storage Organizing Containers, Acrylic Plastic Clear Storage Bins w Handles for Kitchen Organization, Cabinet, Fridge, Freezer, Bathroom, Laundry Organizer- 4 Pack
features: IDEAL STORAGE SOLUTION Sleek and modular design will help you maximize and utilize your space in the best possible way, and make home organization your easiest task. One size fits all and ideal for DIY home organization.

ORGANIZE LIKE A PRO. These acrylic multi-purpose plastic storage bins can be used anywhere & everywhere and will make you look like a home organizing expert. From kitchen to pantry storage, refrigerator and freezer organizers from the bathroom, down to the office and garage; these bins are the best kept secret to effortless home organization.

ACCESSIBLE OPEN TOP. Large open top design makes it simple to grab what you need quickly and easily. A revolutionary problem solver for modern kitchens and hectic households on the go. Use these convenient storage organizing bins for the toy closet, crafts cabinet, laundry room, or entry closet to organize stuff in the most efficient way possible.

MULTI-PURPOSE BINS. Multi purpose storage containers are great for literally any closet or pantry in your home or office. You will be surprised how easily you can now organize the bathroom vanity, arts and crafts closet, toy closet, laundry room, mudroom office and garage.

HIGH QUALITY AND DURABLE. Made from exceptionally high quality BPA free, and shatter resistant plastic, these food storage organizer bins were created to be used. Won't crack or break with regular use. Perfect for the discerning home organizers.
